page.overview:
Who is Iron Back Gray Wolf?

Strategist|base=Folded Mountain-Interlinked Cave|relationship=Great King of South Hill|novel=Chapter 85|alias=Wolf}}

The Iron Back Gray Wolf (铁背苍狼, Tiebei Canglang) was a demon who followed Great King of South Hill.

In his true form, the Iron Back Gray Wolf is a grey-furred wolf with a tough back.

He is cunning and crafty, adept at using strategies to defeat the enemies.
